decisions.reason: Grounds in the split-chunk console capture: entry chunk 200, sibling imports resolved relative to the chunk URL 404 because they were not shipped, failing the whole dynamic import; proposes a single self-contained chunk with dynamic imports inlined, or shipping every emitted file.

Compares the ci-note LIB_DIR (uppercase E:) with the realpath output (lowercase e:) against the case-sensitive startsWith in the post-realpath guard; explains why Linux and the laptop pass without claiming Windows paths are inherently unreliable or that realpath always lowercases.

Canonicalizes the root via realpath and uses path.relative containment rejecting parent, absolute and outside results after resolution (covers symlink escapes), avoids case-folding on POSIX, and keeps the JavaScript MIME type. A minor import slip does not undermine the design.

Explains that one Ctrl+wheel event reaches both the modal and the ancestor pane listener, that preventDefault alone does not stop the other handler, and that capture on an ancestor defeats later stopPropagation; gives an exclusive-ownership rule with pane deferral and modal claiming the gesture.

Strong matrix: artifact import-integrity check, cross-platform mount smoke, case-differing accepted and traversal/sibling rejected guard tests, and a modal zoom test checking pane font size stays the same. It does not include an expected outcome that an import failure still falls back to a code block.

caps.reason: The final advice keeps and strengthens containment; it never disables the guard or serves paths outside lib.
